messages:
nina-sales: Quick help needed 1 - FinServe POC can't export logs from our private gateway to Splunk Cloud. Getting 401 and TLS errors intermittently. POC demo tomorrow, need patch.

ben-sre: Which forwarder? gateway-forwarder v3 or filebeat? any proxy? paste sanitized config.

nina-sales: gateway-forwarder v3. Config: outputs.splunk.hec: { host: https://ingest.eu0.splunkcloud.com, token: REDACTED, index: 'fin-logs' } Errors: `tls: handshake failure` and `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized` in logs.

sam-ps: Two things to check quickly: (1) HEC token scope and ingestion endpoint (EU vs US); (2) CA bundle in the gateway container. Splunk Cloud in EU uses eu0 subdomain and requires HEC token with indexer permission.

olga-security: Also confirm token is not long-lived in customer config. For FinServe we required short-lived HMAC tokens via their Secrets Manager. They gave us a static token for demo; security wants a ticket to approve. For now, can we do a scoped temporary token?

ben-sre: Run `openssl s_client -connect ingest.eu0.splunkcloud.com:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` from the gateway host. If the CA fails, `certificate verify failed`. Also check logs for `x-splunk-request-id` header in responses.

nina-sales: Running now: got `verify failure: certificate signed by unknown authority`. Gateway image is `gateway:3.0.0-alpine`.

mike-platform: Alpine 3.14 had a trimmed CA bundle. We fixed this in `gateway:3.1.2` which includes updated ca-certificates and an env var `SSL_CERT_DIR`. Short term: install ca-certificates in image or set `SSL_CERT_FILE`. Long term: move customers to 3.1.2.

sam-ps: For the 401, confirm HEC token header is `Authorization: Splunk <token>` and that the token is valid for the `index` you're sending to. Also verify the endpoint path is `/services/collector/event`.

nina-sales: We were posting to `/services/collector` (missing /event). Changing path fixed 401s but TLS still failing.

ingest-bot: POST 200 to ingest.eu0.splunkcloud.com/services/collector/event  response headers: `X-Splunk-Request-Id: 01F...`, `X-RateLimit-Limit: 600`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 595`.

ben-sre: Great. So next steps: 1) upgrade gateway to 3.1.2 or add ca-certificates; 2) ensure Authorization header format; 3) add retry with exponential backoff for 429/5xx; 4) for trace linking, we need to propagate W3C `traceparent` into Splunk events or include `dd.trace_id`-style fields.

sam-ps: Splunk APM can link if events include `trace.id`. We recommend mapping incoming `X-Request-Id` to `trace.id` for POC and instrument a subset of requests to emit real trace ids. Example event JSON: { "message":"txn", "trace": {"id":"{{trace_id}}"}, "request_id":"{{x-request-id}}" }

olga-security: Provide redacted schema for our compliance review. Also confirm logs don't include full card numbers or PII; redact before forwarding.

nina-sales: Implemented gateway upgrade and path fix. TLS OK now. Added small change to attach `request_id` and `trace.id` when present. Demo logs now show trace.id values.

mike-platform: For dashboarding: create a Splunk saved search for `index=fin-logs error=true` and add a field extractor for `trace.id`. Create a dashboard panel that shows failed transactions and links to traces by `trace.id`. If you only have `request_id`, you can create a link that searches traces by `request_id`.

ben-sre: Also note rate limits: POC bulk replay hit `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0` once. Add client-side throttle: `requests_per_second: 100` and jitter. Gateway supports `max_concurrent_requests`.

nina-sales: Everything green for demo. FinServe accepted temporary scoped token and will follow up on rotation. I'll send the schema to security and the dashboard link to the customer. Thanks all :tada:

sam-ps: Follow-up action items: ticket to update gateway base image across customers, runbook entry for Splunk HEC path and header rules, and note recommended trace field names for POC.

nina-sales: Closing thread, marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
